item.title: Football: Alexander-Arnold's Problems Continue With Serious Hamstring Injury, Setback For Real Madrid
item.description: Real Madrid Medical Services: Trent Alexander-Arnold's injury-hit start to his Real Madrid career continues with the club confirming he suffered a serious hamstring injury during Wednesday night's 3-0 win away to Athletic Club.

item.title: Nagesh Trophy: Haryana, Odisha Win In 8th Edition Of Men’s National T20 Cricket Tournament For The Blind
item.description: National T20 Cricket Tournament: Cricket Association of Blind (CAB) Haryana dominated CAB Madhya Pradesh, while CAB Odisha outclassed Bihar with a flawless 6-wicket win in the Nagesh Trophy – Men’s National T20 Cricket Tournament for the Blind 2025 (8th Edition) at the Ranital Sports Complex in Jabalpur on Thursday.

item.title: Challenger Trophy Ignites Classification Rounds Of Hockey Men’s Junior World Cup
item.description: Junior World Cup Tamil Nadu: The FIH Hockey Men’s Junior World Cup Tamil Nadu 2025 entered the classification rounds for the 9-16 and 17-24 positions on Thursday in Madurai and Chennai after a day’s break, with teams producing some interesting results.

item.title: Giants Break Losing Streak as Nissanka, Omarzai Power Gulf Giants to Dominant Win Over MI Emirates
item.description: Gulf Giants beat MI Emirates by six wickets as Pathum Nissanka’s 81 and Azmatullah Omarzai’s all-round heroics sealed a dominant ILT20 Season 4 win.

item.title: May They Finish Their Careers With A Trophy: Messi Wants Perfect Farewell For Jordi Alba And Sergio Busquets
item.description: CONCACAF Champions Cup: Lionel Messi said he hopes Inter Miami can give Sergio Busquets and Jordi Alba the farewell they deserve when the pair play the final match of their careers in the MLS Cup title game against the Vancouver Whitecaps.

item.title: Broad Labels Root's Gabba Ton As 'one Of His Best'
item.description: Stuart Broad: Former fast-bowler Stuart Broad has hailed Joe Root for scoring his first Test century Down Under and described his century as 'one of his best' yet.

item.title: Premier League: Late Magassa Goal Helps West Ham Hold Man Utd To 1-1 Draw
item.description: El Hadji Malick Diouf: Soungoutou Magassa’s first goal for West Ham United salvaged a point in a 1-1 draw with Manchester United at Old Trafford.

item.title: Hope’s Century Fuels West Indies’ Fightback vs Injury-Hit New Zealand
item.description: A sparkling century by Shai Hope ably supported by Justin Greaves had the West Indies 212-4 at stumps on Friday and clinging to the remote chance they can save the first Test against New Zealand in Christchurch.

item.title: Bayern Sees Cup Quarterfinal Return As Springboard For Bigger Goals
item.description: UEFA Champions League: Bayern Munich's return to the German Cup quarterfinals for the first time since 2022 has lifted spirits inside the club.

item.title: We'd To Give Back Not Hundreds Of Thousands, But Millions: CA Boss Reflects On Revenue Loss From Perth Test
item.description: Cricket Australia CEO Todd Greenberg: Cricket Australia CEO Todd Greenberg has admitted that the revenue loss from the early finish of the first Ashes Test in Perth did hurt the national body's bottom line, resulting in the giving back "not hundreds of thousands, but million dollars"
